strategy: Diversified portfolio — do NOT put all eggs in one basket. Each category is a separate 'basket' (offline asset, B2B invisible service, legal/claim assistance, arbitrage, micro-SaaS, quiet digital product) so income streams don't correlate.

niches.name: Dumpster & Bin Rental
niches.problem: Roofers, remodelers, flippers and landlords always need bins but incumbents are slow and analog.
niches.audience: Local contractors, property managers, DIY homeowners in your metro.
niches.offer: Buy/lease 8-10 bins, list on Google Maps + Facebook, route with Stripe checkout. $400-500/week per bin.
niches.pitch: The bins nobody competes for — $400/week, cash-flowing while you sleep.

niches.name: Utility Locating Service
niches.problem: Before any dig, law requires utilities located (call 811). Contractors hate the wait and the paperwork.
niches.audience: General contractors, telecom crews, municipalities, excavators.
niches.offer: Certified private utility locating — faster than the public 811, on your schedule.
niches.pitch: They can't dig without you. A high-margin service nobody talks about.

niches.name: ADA Website Compliance Fixer
niches.problem: Small businesses face ADA website lawsuits; most don't know they're non-compliant.
niches.audience: Local service businesses, dentists, restaurants, ecommerce stores with old sites.
niches.offer: Audit + fix WCAG issues (alt text, contrast, keyboard nav) + compliance certificate.
niches.pitch: Avoid a $20k lawsuit for under €2k. Most competitors won't touch it.

niches.name: ISO/Safety Certification Paperwork Help
niches.problem: Small manufacturers want ISO 9001 but drown in documentation and audit prep.
niches.audience: Small factories, machine shops, food producers seeking export readiness.
niches.offer: Ghostwrite the quality manual, procedures, and pre-audit prep — no consultant price tag.
niches.pitch: The cert that unlocks export contracts — without the €10k consultant.

niches.name: Class-Action Claim Filing Assistant
niches.problem: People are owed settlement money but miss deadlines or don't know a case exists.
niches.audience: Consumers in active settlements, data-breach victims, investors.
niches.offer: Curate open settlements, prep the claim forms, file on the client's behalf for a cut.
niches.competition: Low (feels 'too good to be true' so few do it)
niches.pitch: Money already awarded to you — we just file the paperwork.

niches.name: Warranty & Rebate Recovery
niches.problem: People overpay for repairs covered by warranty, or forget rebates they earned.
niches.audience: Busy homeowners, fleet owners, parents with many appliances.
niches.offer: Audit past purchases, file warranty claims / rebates the client forgot, take a percentage.
niches.pitch: We found €400 you already owned. Keep 80%, we take 20%.

niches.name: Retail / Online Arbitrage
niches.problem: Discounted retail goods sell for more on marketplaces; most people won't do the grunt work.
niches.offer: Buy genuine discounted goods, resell on Amazon/bol.com with margin; 100% legal (first-sale doctrine).
niches.competition: Medium (but unsexy grunt work filters most)
niches.pitch: Buy low, sell higher — the oldest quiet money, still legal and working.

niches.name: Peer-to-Peer Storage Rental
niches.problem: People need cheap storage; commercial units are pricey and far.
niches.audience: City dwellers with spare garage/attic/shed; people needing storage.
niches.offer: List your (or bought) spare space on Neighbor; collect rent, zero handling.
niches.pitch: Your empty garage is an ATM. List once, rent forever.

niches.name: Boring Micro-SaaS (finance ops niche)
niches.problem: Solo firms need tiny automation (invoicing, cash-flow, tax reminders) no giant tool covers.
niches.audience: Freelancers, small accounting practices, trades businesses.
niches.offer: A narrow $9-29/mo tool solving one painful, frequent, measurable workflow.
niches.pitch: One boring problem, solved forever, $9/month, compounding.

niches.name: Public-Domain Republishing
niches.problem: Thousands of books/art are free in the public domain but buried and unformatted.
niches.audience: Readers, teachers, niche hobbyists wanting clean editions/merch.
niches.offer: Curate, format, and sell public-domain works as eBooks, print-on-demand, or licensed merch.
niches.pitch: Free raw material, formatted and sold. Zero content cost, forever.

niches.name: Quiet Stock Photography
niches.problem: Buyers need specific, unsexy stock (industrial, medical, B2B, niche hobbies) that's under-supplied.
niches.audience: Agencies, publishers, course creators needing niche visuals.
niches.offer: Shoot/upload undersupplied niches; earn per download, compounding library.
niches.competition: Low in niche verticals (everyone shoots sunsets)
niches.pitch: Boring photos nobody uploads = less competition, steady per-download income.

niches.name: Mobile Notary & Loan Signing
niches.problem: Real-estate deals, wills and contracts need notarization; people want it at home.
niches.audience: Homeowners, realtors, title companies, elderly clients.
niches.offer: Get certified, offer mobile + after-hours notary; specialize in loan signings.
niches.pitch: A stamp that pays €200 an hour. Steady, professional, invisible.
